name: The Deer
description: The primary antagonist of the forest. Extremely fast, highly hostile, and cannot be killed. Avoid at all costs.
behavior: Actively hunts players. Will pursue for long distances.
tips: Campfire light keeps it at bay
Circle around trees to break line of sight

name: The Owl
description: A dangerous aerial entity that appears after certain nights.
behavior: Swoops down on players in open areas.

name: The Ram
description: A powerful ram entity that charges players.
behavior: Charges in straight lines with high knockback.

name: The Bat
description: Aerial entity that appears during night phases.

name: The Cat
description: A swift and dangerous feline entity.
tips: Do not outrun — it will catch you

name: Cultist
description: The most common enemy. Cultists raid your base every night.
behavior: Spawn in groups and attack the campfire and players.

name: Cultist King
description: A powerful summoned boss that appears during specific ritual events.
behavior: High health pool, AoE attacks, summons more cultists.
tips: Keep distance and use ranged weapons

name: Wolf
description: Standard wolves that patrol forest areas.
behavior: Attacks if you enter their territory.

name: Alpha Wolf
description: Larger, stronger wolf with more health and damage.
behavior: Leads wolf packs. More aggressive than standard wolves.

name: Bear
description: A large bear that can deal significant damage.
tips: Big Game Hunter class gets bonus loot

name: Bunny
description: Entirely passive. Good early food source.

name: Horse
description: A passive animal found in open areas.
tips: Can be used for transport in some scenarios

name: Woolly Mammoth
description: Generally passive but will trample players if provoked.
tips: Rich food source if you can kill it
